name: workos
description: WorkOS — five skills for running a Cowork-style markdown workspace: init-workos (one-time bootstrap over an existing project-organized directory), uninit-workos (reversible cleanup via sentinel markers), create-workstation (add a new workstation), session-audit (end-of-session capture), workspace-audit (periodic file health check). Designed to compound context over time and keep CLAUDE.md / MEMORY.md lean.
